name: Sellfy
description_en:
Sellfy is a hosted store builder for creators selling digital downloads, subscriptions, physical products and print-on-demand merchandise. A creator can use a standalone store or embed product widgets and buy buttons in an existing site.

Payments go to the seller’s connected Stripe or PayPal account. Sellfy’s subscription and revenue-cap rules are separate from those processors’ charges and eligibility; a 14-day store-building trial is not the same as a free live selling plan.
description_zh:
Sellfy 是面向创作者的托管商店构建器，可销售数字下载、订阅、实物及按需印刷商品。创作者可使用独立店铺，或在已有网站嵌入商品组件和购买按钮。

款项进入卖家连接的 Stripe 或 PayPal 账户。Sellfy 订阅和收入额度规则，与支付处理费及准入分开；14 天建店试用不等于免费正式销售套餐。

core_features.explanation_en: Sell downloads and subscriptions alongside other product types.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在其他商品类型之外销售下载及订阅。

core_features.explanation_en: Use a hosted storefront, buy buttons or product widgets.
core_features.explanation_zh: 使用托管店面、购买按钮或商品组件。

core_features.explanation_en: Plan choice depends on annual sales, with upgrade/overage conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按年度销售额选择套餐，并有升级超额条件。

review_notes: Vendor descriptions are documentation evidence, not independent validation.
Examples and suitability judgments are editorial guidance. Chinese copy does not establish a Chinese product interface.

sections.title_en: Trace a paid download to the buyer’s access
sections.title_zh: 跟踪付款下载与买方访问
sections.en: A creator could upload a permitted file, write the product description, connect a payment account and inspect checkout and delivery. Before launch, verify an unsuccessful payment and a refunded order as well as the normal purchase. Print-on-demand and physical fulfilment are different workflows from an instant download and require their own cost and delivery checks. No purchase or file delivery was executed.
sections.zh: 创作者可上传允许的文件、填写商品描述、连接支付账户，并核对结账及交付。上线前除了正常购买，还应检查付款失败和退款订单。按需印刷及实物履约不同于即时下载，需分别核对成本配送。本文未执行购买或文件交付。

sections.title_en: Read the annual sales cap before comparing subscription prices
sections.title_zh: 比较订阅价格前先看年度销售上限
sections.en: The pricing page lists annual-billing equivalents of US$22, US$59 and US$119 per month for Starter, Business and Premium, versus monthly payments of US$29, US$79 and US$159. Annual sales caps are US$10,000, US$50,000 and US$200,000. If a seller exceeds the plan and does not upgrade, the FAQ says Sellfy may charge 2% on revenue above the limit. A zero ordinary transaction fee therefore is not an unconditional zero-fee promise.
sections.zh: 定价页列出 Starter、Business、Premium 年付折算每月 22、59、119 美元，逐月付款分别为 29、79、159 美元；年度销售上限为 10,000、50,000、200,000 美元。FAQ 说明超限不升级时，可能对超出收入收 2%。因此常规交易费为零，不等于无条件零费用。

sections.title_en: Payment eligibility and product limits need checking
sections.title_zh: 核对支付资格及商品限制
sections.en: The official FAQ says a seller unable to receive through both supported processors can only offer free products. Processor fees remain additional to the Sellfy subscription. The table shows plan-specific file-size limits, while another FAQ uses a general 10 GB statement; migration entitlement text also differs between the table and FAQ. Confirm the operative limit and service scope for your files rather than selecting the most generous sentence.
sections.zh: 官方 FAQ 说明若两种受支持支付方式都无法收款，只能提供免费商品；支付处理费也在 Sellfy 订阅之外另计。表格显示按套餐分文件大小，而另一 FAQ 使用通用 10 GB 说法，迁移权益在表格和 FAQ 也有差异。应确认自身文件实际适用额度和服务范围，不能挑最宽松表述。

sections.title_en: Use the trial to prepare a creator store
sections.title_zh: 用试用准备创作者商店
sections.en: A creator with an existing audience and a manageable catalogue has a relevant use case. A multi-vendor marketplace or complex warehouse operation needs a different scope. The homepage says selling requires upgrading the trial store to a paid plan. Prepare files, rights, gateway account, tax/shipping inputs and refund ownership. No hosting-region, source-code/self-hosting licence, subscription recovery or independent sales outcome was verified.
sections.zh: 已有受众、目录可管理的创作者有相关场景。多卖家市场或复杂仓储需求则不同。主页说明试用店须升级付费才能销售。应准备文件、权利、支付账户、税配送输入及退款责任。本文未核实托管地区、源码自托管许可、订阅恢复或独立销售效果。
